description:
Use this when you need an auditable Hungary working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when hungary 2026 general Monday-Friday work schedule only (Labour Code section 97(2), NGM 10/2025). Requires explicit work_schedule. Eleven statutory holidays and three paired transfers are included; three Saturdays are working. No shift, personal, bank, exchange, school, local-office opening or payroll schedule is inferred. No automatic substitute Monday. The annual decree expires 2027-01-01; later schedules require new evidence.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range. Requires an explicit general Monday-Friday work schedule; includes three working Saturdays and paired rest dates.
Example user requests: Count Hungary working days around Working Saturday compensates August 21. | Count Hungary working days around Christmas Eve is transferred rest, not statutory holiday. | Count Hungary working days around Whit Monday.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-08-07","end_date":"2026-08-10","work_schedule":"general_monday_friday"}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, is_transferred_rest_day, is_makeup_working_day, transfer_pair, payroll_scope.
Formula: working = published makeup day OR (weekday AND not statutory holiday AND not transferred rest)
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/hungary-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/hungary-public-working-days-between.md

work_schedule.description: Required: confirm the general Monday-Friday work schedule under Labour Code 97(2). Do not use for shifts or institution-specific opening.

name: count_hu_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_makeup_working_day.description: Whether result.date is a published working Saturday.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a Labour Code 102(1) holiday.

is_transferred_rest_day.description: Whether result.date is one of the three NGM rest dates.

public_holidays_counted.description: All retained calendar events, including working Saturdays; event count is not a rest-day count.

substitute_day_policy.description: Only three published 2026 transfer pairs; no substitute Monday inferred

transfer_pair.description: Paired working/rest dates and legal basis for result.date, otherwise empty object.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Hungary Working Days
